title: Profanity Shield
description: Ever thought that Minecraft players used too many insults? Well, this mod solves it once and for all!
body:
In its config folder this mod allows you to configure a `profanities.txt` where they're all grouped (1 word per line) and a `replacements.txt` which will randomly be picked to replace a profanity when one is sent in the chat.  
The replaced word will be underlined and you can hover your mouse over it to see the original word.  

Enjoy :)
